title: ASC 842 Lease Accounting - DemoCo Office Lease OFF-001
conclusionSummary: DemoCo's 36-month office lease is an operating lease: none of the ASC 842-10-25-2 criteria is met. The 36 payments of 10,000 USD in arrears discount at the 6% incremental borrowing rate to a lease liability of 328,710.16 USD at commencement, with an equal right-of-use asset; the single straight-line lease cost is 10,000 USD a month and the liability retires with the final payment.
